parameters.query:
SELECT id, "prUrl", "jenkinsJobName", "createdAt"
FROM incidents
WHERE "prUrl" LIKE '%/pull/{{ $('Extract Validation Context').first().json.prNumber }}'
   OR "prUrl" LIKE '%/pull/{{ $('Extract Validation Context').first().json.prNumber }}/%'
ORDER BY "createdAt" DESC
LIMIT 1;
